<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.54.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes 🛠
* Remove experimental query params by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13142
* Remove deprecated `st.experimental_user` command by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13626
* Set `add_rows` deprecation warning to show in browser by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13628
### New Features 🎉
* Use `key` as main identity for `st.dataframe` with selections by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13558
* Use `key` as main identity for vega charts with selections by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13559
* Add `chartDivergingColors` theming config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13581
* Allow dynamically changing in min and max in `st.date_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13549
* Allow dynamically changing `min_value` and `max_value` in `st.datetime_input` when `key` is provided by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13620
* Prepare pandas 3.0 compatibility by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13630
* Allow dynamic changes to `st.radio` options when `key` is provided by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13611
* Support auto-rerun when `config.toml` is created by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13625
* Allow selecting text of pills in the `MultiselectColumn` and `ListColumn` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13663
* Prepare for binding widgets to query params - Part 1 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13681
* feat(logo): add support for Material icons and emojis in st.logo by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13416
* Allow dynamic changes to `st.select_slider` options when `key` is provided by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13696
* Add "client.showErrorLinks` config option (#11238)" by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13472
* Allow dynamic changes to `st.pydeck_chart` parameters when `key` is provided  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13703
* Support resolving to theme colors configs for charts by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13739
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Fix bar chart error with uniform column values by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13590
* [fix] Increase max width of uploaded files in `st.chat_input` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13589
* [fix] Add defensive check in Manifest Scanner by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13612
* Support new auth features in Starlette by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13571
* Hide developer options when toolbarMode="viewer" by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13623
* Fix SnowflakeConnection.query() cache key to include params by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13652
* Fix crash with container elements in spinner context by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13659
* Fix a regression with snowflake connection being closed by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13665
* Fix TransientNode not capturing BlockNode as anchor when replacing by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13674
* Fix selectbox and multiselect clearing selections for custom objects by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13648
* Fix `KeyError` when sorting melted bar chart data by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13695
* Fix sidebar collapsing on mobile when clicking portaled elements by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13653
* [fix] Display wildcard addresses as localhost in URLs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13720
### Other Changes
* [chore] Release v1.53.0 by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13588
* [chore] Release v1.53.1 by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13676

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13590
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13416
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13004
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13472

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.53.1...1.54.0
